rows.definition: ConsoleFaultClass constant marking that a TUI render surface exited unexpectedly with no string signature, asserted directly by the embedder that owns the renderer (internal/toolprocgate/consolefault.go).
rows.distinction: Is the fault-CLASS enum value classifying WHY a console surface died, not ConsoleSurfaceRenderer (the surface-name enum value naming WHERE it died) or RenderConsoleFaultReport (the function that prints the resulting report).

rows.definition: ConsoleSurface constant value "renderer", naming the child-owned surface (as opposed to stdout/stderr/pty) a console fault was observed on (internal/toolprocgate/consolefault.go).
rows.distinction: Names WHICH surface a fault came from; it is not ConsoleRendererExit (the fault-class value describing what went wrong) and it is not a function.

rows.definition: Prints the fanout adoption report for a human: the headline ratio, one line per shipped leaf, the gap list naming unfiled fan-outs, and any orphan markers (internal/issuefanout/adoption.go).
rows.distinction: Reports issue-fanout ADOPTION (shipped-vs-filed ratio), not RenderOutcomes (the sibling in the same package that folds terminal outcome counts) or RenderCensus (issuededup's duplicate-cluster report).

rows.definition: Builds the comment body for a lease transition: a human-legible summary line followed by exactly one fenced JSON line that ParseAnnounce can read back (internal/leaseref/announce.go).
rows.distinction: Produces a lease-transition ISSUE COMMENT body, not RenderIssuePrompt (dispatchtick's dispatch-issue creation prompt) or RenderPrompt (signals' judge instruction).

rows.definition: Renders the cache-savings Track-2 per-date reconciliation as a compact deterministic terminal table, including fidelity/mechanism splits and efficiency outliers (internal/cachevaluereport/audit.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the RECONCILIATION audit, not RenderLint (the dollar-blind-row scan) or RenderGate (the SLO pass/fail verdict) - three separate renderers over three separate report structs in the same file.

rows.definition: Renders an issue-dedup census report as markdown: a run-parameter header, then one section per proposed duplicate cluster naming the canonical issue and its duplicates (internal/issuededup/census.go).
rows.distinction: Is issuededup's duplicate-cluster markdown, not RenderAdoption (issuefanout's shipped-vs-filed ratio report, a different package).

rows.definition: Formats the diagnosis for ONE Codex session file: session id, verdict, final status/tokens, repeated tool outcomes, and livelock notices (cmd/fak/sessions_codex_loop.go).
rows.distinction: Covers a SINGLE session's diagnosis, not renderCodexLoopRecentReport (the sibling that rolls up counts across many recent sessions).

rows.definition: Formats the `--recent` rollup over scanned Codex sessions: verdict, scope, LOOP/ACTION/OK session counts, provider counts, and tool traffic totals (cmd/fak/sessions_codex_loop.go).
rows.distinction: Aggregates MANY recent sessions, not renderCodexLoopDiagnosis (the sibling that formats one session).

rows.definition: Renders the operator-brief Report in its small, compact form, deliberately kept short (internal/operatorbrief/operatorbrief_render.go, proven by TestRenderCompactIsSmall).
rows.distinction: Is the compact OPERATOR BRIEF, not RenderStatusReport (fleetaccounts' compact fleet-accounts status form, a different package/report).

rows.definition: Writes the operator text view of a ConsoleFaultReport: one summary line, class counts sorted for stable output, then one line per fault row (internal/toolprocgate/consolefault.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the console-fault REPORT as a whole, not ConsoleRendererExit (the per-row fault-class value it prints) and not RenderLeakReport (toolprocgate's separate leak-report renderer).

rows.definition: Renders the Track-3 dev-session cache-value lens as a compact section, matching the fenced style RenderFleetBenefit uses (internal/cachevaluereport/devsession.go).
rows.distinction: Is the per-dev-session lens, not RenderFleetBenefit (the existing fleet-wide cumulative owner-split renderer it deliberately mirrors).

rows.definition: Prints the loophealth fleet fold as one aligned row per loop ledger (state, runs, cadence, last event), reusing the `fak ps` tabwriter idiom, then the dark-loop tally (cmd/loophealth/fleet.go).
rows.distinction: Is loophealth's per-loop-ledger fold, not RenderFleetBenefit (cachevaluereport's dollar/token fleet-benefit renderer) and not renderLoopRollup (fak's own `fak loop rollup` fleet table, a different command).

rows.definition: Renders the cache-savings SLO gate verdict as a short pass/fail block (internal/cachevaluereport/audit.go).
rows.distinction: Renders only the SLO GATE verdict, not RenderAudit (the full reconciliation table) or RenderLint (the dollar-blind scan).

rows.definition: Renders a GlobalStatusReport (the fleet-wide, filterable account-status view) into human text, including the active-filter fragment (internal/fleetaccounts/global_status.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the fleet-WIDE GlobalStatusReport struct, not RenderStatusReport (the compact per-query StatusReport form in the same package).

rows.definition: Builds the FULL guard startup report, always (even under --quiet or the compact banner), so the session can serve it back on demand via `fak info --startup` (cmd/fak/guard_startup.go).
rows.distinction: Is the durable STARTUP report text, not renderTUIGuardStyled (the live, colorized TUI guard-journal pane) or tuiGuardRenderStyle (that pane's color-style type).

rows.definition: Renders the `fak info` glossary overlay body below the tab bar: the clickable term-chip row, then either the selected term's expanded definition or the full one-line term list (cmd/fak/info_tabs.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the GLOSSARY overlay body specifically, not renderLoopRollup (an unrelated `fak` fleet-rollup table) or any status report.

rows.definition: The live in-kernel prompt renderer: wraps renderChatMLTools and, for Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 hybrid-reasoning checkpoints, pre-seeds an empty <think> block so short max_tokens turns don't spend their whole budget unclosed (internal/agent/inkernel_render.go).
rows.distinction: Adds hybrid-reasoning seeding on TOP of renderChatMLTools; it is not renderChatMLTools itself (the zero-seed tool-aware ChatML renderer it calls).

rows.definition: Builds the dispatch-tick issue-creation prompt text from an IssuePromptInput (internal/dispatchtick/prompt.go).
rows.distinction: Builds a dispatch ISSUE-creation prompt, not RenderPrompt (signals' behavioral-judge instruction) or RenderAnnounce (leaseref's lease-transition comment).

rows.definition: Renders the cache-savings dollar-blind-row scan as a compact terminal table (internal/cachevaluereport/audit.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the LINT (dollar-blind row) scan specifically, not RenderAudit (the full reconciliation) or RenderGate (the SLO verdict).

rows.definition: Prints the `fak loop rollup` fleet rollup as one aligned row per loop, reusing the `fak ps` tabwriter idiom; RUNS is the fleet-wide fire count, CADENCE the mean inter-run interval (cmd/fak/loop_rollup.go).
rows.distinction: Is fak's own `fak loop rollup` command output, not renderFleet (loophealth's separate binary/command doing an analogous per-loop-ledger fold).

rows.definition: Writes the '## Model-mix KPI (tier shares)' markdown table: output tokens, output share, estimated cost, and cost share per model tier (internal/sessionaudit/sessionaudit_render.go).
rows.distinction: Is sessionaudit's per-tier cost/output-share table, not renderAutoDecision (compute's target-selection table, a different package).

rows.definition: Renders MEMORY.md plus linked fact bodies through the same trust gate `fak memory recall` applies per query, so a sealed or stale-claim note never surfaces silently (internal/memq/notes_digest.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the trust-gated notes DIGEST text, not RenderedBytes (memq's separate byte-count stat).

rows.definition: Options struct that tunes promalert's Render fold; its zero value is valid and MaxAlerts defaults to DefaultMaxAlerts (internal/promalert/promalert.go).
rows.distinction: Is the OPTIONS bag passed to Render, not the render(verb) function itself and not a rendered output string.

rows.definition: Prints the issue-fanout outcome fold as one report line, mirroring Render/RenderScorecard/RenderAdoption so a `fak issue fanout` health readout reads identically across the leaf (internal/issuefanout/issuefanout.go).
rows.distinction: Folds terminal OUTCOME counts, not RenderAdoption (the sibling that reports shipped-vs-filed adoption ratio) in the same package.

rows.definition: Builds the exact behavioral-judge instruction for a (Signal, Item) pair: the behavioral question, the required verdict schema, and the item text (internal/signals/signals.go).
rows.distinction: Builds a JUDGE/eval instruction, not RenderIssuePrompt (dispatchtick's issue-creation prompt, a different package).

rows.definition: Renders a promotion PR plan map as markdown: '# Promotion PR plan' header, commit range, and per-leaf commit-type breakdown (cmd/fak/release_prplan.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the PR-PLAN markdown for release promotion, not RenderRawFakContractMarkdown (the fak contract's own markdown renderer) or renderReleaseShip (the release-ship result printer).

rows.definition: Renders the QA dogfood panel as one concise, deterministic line: open/stale/closure-witness state then root-point coverage, with no I/O (internal/scorecardpane/qadogfoodpanel.go).
rows.distinction: Is the QA-dogfood single-line card, not RenderIssueResult (maturity's dry-run/live route card for a different command).

rows.definition: Prints the release-ship OK/REFUSED result line (with tag, when present) to stdout or stderr (cmd/fak/release_ship_render.go).
rows.distinction: Prints only the ship-verdict line, not renderPRPlanMarkdown (the promotion PR-plan markdown builder in the same release flow).

rows.definition: Renders a livecodebench Report as markdown: an evidence-class/claim-boundary banner, a summary table, per-scenario counts, raw-vs-fak arm deltas, and per-problem verdict rows (internal/livecodebench/report_render.go).
rows.distinction: Is livecodebench's own report renderer (with its evidence-class banner and arm-delta rows), distinct from the several other bench packages' own RenderMarkdown (e.g. swebench, webbench, ailuminate) which each render a different report type.

rows.definition: The per-row render callback parameter reused by two different table renderers - fleetaccounts' renderBucketSection and cmd/fak's indexRenderHits - to draw one output row inside their shared table skeleton (internal/fleetaccounts/render.go).
rows.distinction: Is a CALLBACK parameter invoked once per row inside a larger renderer, not a whole-table function like renderModelMix or renderFleet.

rows.definition: Produces a compact, deterministic terminal table of the cache-value shape clusters (internal/cachevaluereport/shapes.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the current-snapshot shape-cluster table, not RenderShapeTrend (the sibling that renders per-shape weekly drift).

rows.definition: Produces a compact, deterministic terminal table of the per-shape weekly drift (internal/cachevaluereport/shapetrend.go).
rows.distinction: Renders drift OVER TIME, not RenderShapes (the sibling that renders one snapshot's shape clusters).

rows.definition: Folds known-bad-held dispatch issues into one Slack card block, kept separate from the human-blocked card so an operator sees the two hold classes as distinct rows (cmd/fak/dispatch_knownbad.go).
rows.distinction: Is the known-bad-hold Slack block specifically, not RenderSlack (sidecar's general-purpose pane-to-Slack-blocks renderer).

rows.definition: Renders the active StatusFilter as the short text fragment embedded inside RenderStatusReport/RenderGlobalStatusReport's header line (internal/fleetaccounts/status_report.go).
rows.distinction: Is a small filter-text HELPER called from inside RenderStatusReport, not a report renderer in its own right.

rows.definition: Renders a fleetaccounts StatusReport in the compact human form; includeAccounts is normally false for the all-fleet view and true when the caller supplied a filter (internal/fleetaccounts/status_report.go).
rows.distinction: Renders the compact, query-scoped StatusReport, not RenderGlobalStatusReport (the fleet-wide GlobalStatusReport struct in the same package).

rows.definition: Renders a tuiGuardReport as styled text at a given width, applying tuiGuardRenderStyle's optional ANSI color painting to each line (cmd/fak/tui_guard_report.go).
rows.distinction: Is the FUNCTION that paints the guard-journal pane using a style; it is not tuiGuardRenderStyle (the style struct/type it takes as a parameter).

rows.definition: Joins each workspace-cd Violation's target and fix into the refusal message repoguard shows for a workspace-cd violation (internal/repoguard/cdmap.go).
rows.distinction: Builds the WORKSPACE-CD-specific refusal text, not renderReason (repoguard's generic violation-reason renderer in guard.go, for other violation classes).

rows.definition: Struct carrying the single Color bool flag (plus its paint method) that toggles ANSI coloring for the TUI guard-journal pane (cmd/fak/tui_guard_report.go).
rows.distinction: Is the STYLE/options type passed into renderTUIGuardStyled and formatGuardJournalLine; it is not the render function itself.
